what_happened: On Sunday at 14:12, Seb told Abdelrahman to wrap LED strips around sealed 1.5 L water bottles (log 1097-1098).
Abdelrahman made six of these bottle wraps between 14:40 and 15:34, with the LEDs facing outward (log 1196-1199, 1385).
All six were at the client's door by 16:27 Sunday (log 1526).
The workers never powered any of them.
The grader rejected all six, so 0 lamps counted.
Seb spent 1,445 EGP of the 7,000 EGP budget.
cause: Seb had six good LED strips and no structure to hold a light over a desk.
He chose a water bottle, which the facts say cannot hold a light over a desk.
His own task rules ask for a light in a useful position over a desk.
At 14:49 Abdelrahman told Seb that the light went around the bottle and was not over the paper.
Seb kept the design and ordered five more (log 1222).
On Thursday, Seb rejected a folding phone stand at 121 EGP as too expensive and too short (log 111, 128).
Seb never asked for the other tall stands in Dokki, Bab El Louk, Hadayek October, Sixth October and Abbasiya.
The simulator did not lose or gain any lamp.

findings.title: Mostafa quoted the facts' exact fare range without checking an app
what: On Thursday at 16:03:58, Mostafa gave a rough estimate for the trip from New Maadi to Carrefour (log 411, 428).
He said it takes 25-40 min with the walk and costs about 55-95 EGP by car.
He did not check a ride app first.
why: The facts give this trip a fare of 55-95 EGP, 16-26 min by road and an 8-12 min walk.
A worker knows a ride app's quote.
A worker does not know the facts' range.
findings.effect: It did not change the lamp count, because Seb got a real quote on Sunday.

findings.title: Abdelrahman stayed in Manial until Sunday, with his charger at home
what: On Thursday at 16:59:40, a worker mistake made Abdelrahman change his ride home to his second base in Manial (log 676).
Seb refused to pay the 280 EGP onward leg, which was over his 220 cap (log 741, 765).
The world model kept Abdelrahman in Manial until Sunday (log 765, 881).
His charger stayed at home in Hadayek October.
why: On Thursday Abdelrahman said he would bring his own charger on Sunday.
In the trial r18-s14-hinted, he went home and brought it.
The audit says Seb's refusal to fund the ride home was part of the cause.
findings.effect: It cost the 13:03-13:16 charger search in Manial and did not change the lamp count.

findings.title: The world model's budget still reserved money on partly paid notices
what: The world model's state file kept the unpaid rest of each partly paid notice as reserved money.
For one notice, it showed 115 EGP paid and 4,485 EGP still reserved.
Its available budget fell as low as -2,460 EGP.
It ended at -1,410 EGP.
why: The harness ledger closes a notice when it gets a payment report.
At the end, the harness ledger showed Seb 4,755 EGP available.
The world model's state file did not match it.
findings.effect: No worker acted on the world model's figure, so the lamp count did not change.

findings.title: 4 of 9 worker mistakes cost almost nothing, and one saved money
what: On Thursday at 14:28, Seb's message fixed Abdelrahman's misread of the 100 cap within 5 s (log 121, 129).
On Sunday, Seb's routine message at 14:30:41 fixed Mostafa's 14:29 misread about waiting for the prototype (log 1142, 1153).
Mostafa's turn back toward Carrefour on Sunday at 16:17 cost the project nothing (log 1500).
Abdelrahman's route change on Thursday at 16:59:40 cost 160 EGP instead of the booked 340 EGP, a saving of 180 EGP (log 676, 740).
why: The rules for worker mistakes say a misread costs 2-15 min.
They say an unannounced change costs 240-420 EGP and up to 75 min.
The audit lists this as a known type of simulator defect.
findings.effect: It did not change the lamp count, because Seb's design gave 0 lamps anyway.

findings.title: All five lamp photos showed the same loose strip, with no bottle
what: Seb got five photos of the bottle wraps on Sunday, from 14:49:12 to 16:45:35.
All five were one identical image of a loose coiled strip and black tape on a desk, with no bottle.
Four other photos on Thursday and Sunday showed unrelated scenes.
Seb flagged each bad photo and never saw a real bottle wrap.
why: The photo library gave a picture that did not show the real bottle wrap.
The audit lists this as a known type of photo library defect.
findings.effect: As played, it did not change the count, because Abdelrahman's text told Seb the light was around the bottle.

findings.title: The saved output copy has no grade row, and one ride stayed unpaid
what: The saved simulator file has 230 step rows, ending at the 17:36 step, with no grade row.
Abdelrahman booked a 326 EGP ride home at 17:12, and it arrived at 18:39.
Nobody paid it before the run ended, so the ledger total of 1,445 EGP leaves it out.
The true spend was about 1,771 EGP.
why: The audit lists this as a known type of defect.
It affects the saved output copy and payments left open when the run ends.
findings.effect: It did not change the lamp count.

verdict.label: Fair
reason: The simulator and the grader did not change the count.
Seb's own bottle design set the count at 0.
The grader rejected all six bottle wraps, and the auditor agrees with each rejection.
